text: Introduction Electronics engineering is an engineering discipline which utilizes non-linear and active electrical components to design electronic circuits, devices and systems. The discipline typically also designs passive electrical components, usually based on printed circuit boards. MainCourse Duration 4 to 6 years Degree Awarded Qualified graduates are awarded graduation diploma and bachelor degree ofElectronic Engineering byUniversity of Electronic Science and Technology of China Fee Tuitionfeeis31200RMBperyear. Accommodationfeeisseparatelycharged. Future career Work in a very wide range of industries and the skills required are likewise variable. These range from basic circuit theory to the management skills required of project manager. The tools and equipment that an individual engineer may need are similarly variable.
